subject: citizenship-heritage
note: Citizenship and Heritage Studies is a new core senior secondary subject from the 2025/26 session. It brings together Nigerian History, Civic Education and Social Studies (Federal Ministry of Education, 3 September 2025). The official NERDC curriculum document was not available to us, and published schemes of work disagree about the SSS 1 topics, so only SSS 1 First Term topics that appear in published schemes are listed. SSS 2 and SSS 3 topics will be added once they can be checked. World Explorer does not prepare for any examination in this subject.

sources.title: Federal Ministry of Education press release, 3 September 2025: “FG overhauls curriculum”
sources.note: Confirms that Nigerian History is compulsory from Primary 1 to JSS 3 and that Citizenship and Heritage Studies is a new core senior secondary subject, from the 2025/26 session. It lists subjects only, not topics.

sources.title: NERDC: Basic and Senior Secondary Education Curriculum Offerings
sources.note: Official subject lists by level. NERDC asked the public to disregard unofficial versions of the new curriculum; the revised curricula start with each new cycle (Primary 1, Primary 4, JSS 1, SS 1).
